country.evidence_quote: Though games have been a big part of his life since he was a child, Reiner initially studied at universities in Germany and the USA to become a doctor of mathematics and then worked as an IT manager and bank director in Germany and England. When he reached 40, he decided it was time for a major change. Life should be fun. Games are fun. And people should have fun with games. So, from then on, he fully dedicating his life to game design, and his motto became: Bringing enjoyment to the people!

contact.name: Michèle Buck
contact.evidence_quote: Your first point of contact when you get in touch with us will either be Michèle Buck or Britta Stöckmann. ... Michèle is our operational wizard, keeping us organised whilst liaising with our designers, partners and clients. She is a true all-rounder with a zest for life and a knack for keeping everything in perfect order, even the chaos of her sock drawer.

alternates.name: Britta Stöckmann
alternates.evidence_quote: Your first point of contact when you get in touch with us will either be Michèle Buck or Britta Stöckmann. ... Britta is our licensing wizard, liaising with our publishers to bring our games to the worldwide markets. She quickly discovered where Reiner hides his bow tie collection (but she has not been looking for the socks – yet!).
alternates.why_chosen: Secretary / administration (last resort). Britta Stöckmann is identified as a primary point of contact for the team and handles licensing.
